note: Macao's Identification Services Bureau handles nationality applications (naturalising as a Chinese national, renouncing, restoring, choosing or changing nationality) under the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and Law 7/1999 on its application to Macao residents, as the Government's service page sets out. So a Macao Chinese resident's nationality is China's, and so are the rules on naturalising and on keeping it. The choice of nationality open to residents of Chinese and Portuguese descent isn't modelled.
